text: FUCK! You have a fuck ass pimple on your nose.
So you pop it the fuck off your nose.
But wait... the same pimple keeps showing up. Now it's on your cheek.
Fuck it, pop it again. Great, now it's on your chin.
You keep popping this goddamn pimple but it keeps showing up everywhere. Your face, your legs, your back... YOUR ASS!
And it keeps getting bigger and bigger. Now it's the size of a pickup truck. Right on your ass... fucking... great.
So you climb your fat ass onto the roof of your house and jump, hoping to pop this... FUCKING PIMPLE THAT WON'T GO AWAY!
It doesn't pop, you dumbass. You bounce around like a dumbass. Pimple basketball.
All the way across town, onto the fucking highway... and a truck hauling safety pins, of all things, is coming your way.
BOOM! A needle pops your fat ass butt pimple, and the explosion is so violent it flies your ass across town...
right back into your house. No more pimple.
